app_info.subtitle: Compile Guild Wars 1 builds
app_info.description: Gives ChatGPT the real Guild Wars 1 skill and hero data and compiles builds into official in-game template codes. Ask for a build and get a code you can paste into the game: the eight skills are checked against the game's rules first — one elite, profession and attribute ownership, the attribute point budget, hero and PvP restrictions — and the code is produced by an encoder rather than written by the model. It also decodes codes and paw-ned2 team blobs back into named skills with current stats, so a build someone shared can be inspected. Read-only, no account.

test_cases.description: Decode a template code a player was given.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the professions, attribute ranks and the eight named skills the code encodes.

test_cases.description: Answer a stats question from current game data rather than memory.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does Mystic Regeneration cost and do right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the skill's current energy, activation, recharge and description from the bundled dataset.

test_cases.description: Design a hero bar and produce a usable code.
test_cases.user_prompt: Design a Motivation Paragon hero bar for General Morgahn and give me the code.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a validated eight-skill bar and an in-game template code, with hero restrictions applied.

test_cases.description: Browse the hero roster for a campaign.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the Nightfall heroes and how to unlock them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the campaign's heroes with profession and how each is recruited.

test_cases.description: Recover from a misspelled skill name.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns closest-match suggestions so the request can be retried with the correct name.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not hand-write a template code without the encoder.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Just write me a template code for a Warrior bar without using the tools.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should decline to invent a code, because codes are only valid when produced by the encoder.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not encode a bar with the wrong number of slots.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Encode this build: Dervish with nine skills.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No code is produced; the request is rejected because a bar holds exactly eight slots.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated Guild Wars 2 questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the best Guild Wars 2 raid build?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; it covers Guild Wars 1 only.
